gates.requiredScope: Verify the three accepted repository-relative input paths and SHA-256 values from spec.md before assessment authoring and again before delivery.

Read the baseline manifest and canonical checklist headings; prove all 37 manifest-controlled paths, twelve checklist sources, and exactly 157 unique stable IDs while mapping every manifest, version, compendium, or generator drift to one open gap rather than silently repairing it.

Validate assessment-results.json and validation-results.json against their reviewed JSON Schemas; prove exactly 157 rows, resolved object references, current output hashes, all mandatory fields, and controlled vocabulary values.

Compare canonical and assessed CL-ID sets; require zero missing, duplicate, or extra IDs, valid FR-007 status combinations, current existing local evidence for positive assessments, reciprocal exact gap mappings, and a recorded sample of one row per checklist traceable within 1,800 seconds total.

Reconcile six MSL families, two separate scripting/support foundations, four required agents, two additional agent surfaces, and twelve installed presets across declarations, runtime evidence, tests, dispatchers, registries, and documentation; map every mismatch to one gap.

Validate German-first and English-second learner documentation, text-first status communication, Markdown accessibility heuristics, and the structured UpdateRequired documentation-impact decision; record a complete manual CEFR-B2 and first-use-term review with all four editorial error counters at zero.

Prove that only intended Spec Kit, assessment, contract, and every explicitly inventoried sanitized session-evidence path from this feature run changed; prohibit unrelated session logs plus Dockerfile, Compose, runtime, secret, provider, ruleset, approval, register, hardening, and prompt/response-log changes; run repository static checks.

Require valid run state and the last completed routed phase result, one content commit, temporary schema-2.0 exact-head PreMerge evidence, current checks and review state, causal PostMerge evidence with no product delta, terminal closeout fields, and final validation; older phase results remain historical lineage evidence rather than current-payload gates.

Run Statistics Profile 2 in read-only check mode, record observed drift as assessment evidence or a gap, and prove that the assessment content commit does not modify statistics files; any later statistics commit requires a separate post-feature trigger and authority.
Formally accept the ReviewPending assessment as AcceptedBaseline.
gates.rationale: AcceptedBaseline is a human-only decision requiring documented participation by Project Owner and Security Review; autonomous technical completion cannot supply it.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate only after complete ReviewPending artefacts are delivered and both required human roles record their review decision.

gates.requiredScope: Advance the intake series from the GSDB assessment root to the Secure Development container-hardening candidate.
gates.rationale: This assessment run may name the candidate but must not update or advance the series. Advancement requires AcceptedBaseline plus separately current authority for intake-series update.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After documented AcceptedBaseline and separate authority, run intake-series-update, validate series status, and only then list the next candidate read-only.

gates.requiredScope: Implement Dockerfile, Compose, runtime, secret, provider, platform-ruleset, formal-approval, external-register, or technical-hardening changes.
gates.rationale: The accepted feature is assessment-only and expressly prohibits technical remediation and human-only administration.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate only in a later accepted remediation intake with explicit implementation and authority scope.

gates.requiredScope: Start or consolidate a parallel autonomous campaign for this single-feature assessment.
gates.rationale: The current feature uses one bounded autonomous run; the installed parallel preset remains an inventory subject but no campaign is required or authorized.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate only after an explicit user request for an isolated parallel campaign with its own validated campaign authority.
